text:
lee: deploy-bot paused the analytics canary — mismatch between chart.lock and requested subchart version for events-subchart. canary id canary-analytics-2026-03. anyone free to triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: detected Chart.lock subchart version mismatch. requested analytics v5.0.2 + events v2.2.0, deployed artifact references events v2.1.7. 3/30 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. logs: /deploy/logs/1805009999

mira: looking. PR bumped events to 2.2.0 but Chart.lock in artifacts was not updated. CI chart-publish likely saw no diff and skipped.

lee: options: (1) quick pin to events-2.1.7, (2) re-run chart publish to push events-2.2.0, (3) rollback. Ops preference?

ops-admin: prefer republish so artifacts match git. approve publish. Meanwhile pin to avoid churn.

mira: applying pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-analytics-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=events-2.1.7 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin received. Canary will not replace pods for pinned subchart.

mira: running `make charts && chart-publisher --repo artifacts --token $TOKEN` now. ETA ~10m. I'll run a `helm diff` on default values between 2.1.7 and 2.2.0 while publish runs.

oncall-sre: stand by on monitoring. Hold release window +30m post-unpause.

mira: diff shows only a doc string change and a default timeout bumped from 30s -> 35s. No breaking changes. Publish succeeded: https://artifacts.internal/charts/analytics/5.0.2+sub-events-2.2.0.tgz sha256: f00dbeef

lee: removing pin and resuming canary: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-analytics-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-analytics-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring for 30m. Initial health checks passing.

ops-admin: filing CI ticket to prevent skipped publishes when Chart.lock differs (ticket #2450).

lee: adding release-note blurb and artifact link, closing unless regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
